dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Certainly. We can keep the conversation focused without going through a lengthy portfolio review. Before we turn to the appointment, have you managed to leave yourself some time away from work this weekend?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That's the plan. 周末想待在家里，陪家人吃饭，不安排应酬。Nothing elaborate, just some reading and perhaps a walk if the weather is pleasant. In logistics, something always seems to need attention, so an empty diary is quite appealing.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: That sounds like a welcome break from the office. I'll keep our conversation to the matters for this appointment. Let's begin with your identification details, and then we can move into the investment discussion.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Alex. I recommend that you buy Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'll keep that in mind. 电话里直接谈重点比较方便。I spend enough time reading business papers during the day; for banking appointments, I prefer a focused conversation with room to pause and look at my notes.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can work that way. There is no need to rush your notes, and if an office interruption comes up, just let me know that you need a pause. I will keep the administrative points separate rather than talking over you.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That arrangement works for the conversation. My papers are here beside me, and the office should stay quiet now. 我已经把工作电话交给同事接听了。We can turn to the appointment itself.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Alex. That brings us to the end of the telephone discussion. For future appointment arrangements, would you prefer us to contact you directly rather than leave scheduling messages with your office? I'm referring only to arranging a conversation.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for letting me know your preference. We can keep scheduling messages brief. I'll let you return to your day now, and I hope you enjoy the quiet weekend you have planned.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
